overall_notes: This paper focuses on protein-language modeling rather than traditional NLG evaluation. The NLG task is limited to function description generation as one of several protein-language applications. Evaluation is primarily through retrieval metrics (Recall@K) and classification metrics (AUPR, F_max, accuracy) rather than traditional NLG metrics like BLEU or ROUGE. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some minor duplicates and capitalization inconsistencies.
